init_incremental_state: init the FairseqIncrementalState class to generate a unique UUID for incremental state tracking
get_incremental_state: get the incremental state dictionary for a given key from an nn.Module
set_incremental_state: set the incremental state dictionary for a given key in an nn.Module
get_full_incremental_state_key: get the full incremental state key by combining the module UUID with a provided key string
with_incremental_state: apply the with_incremental_state decorator to add FairseqIncrementalState as a base class to an existing class
